description: This file defines the interface for WSC (Wi-Fi Simple Configuration) message handling in the IEEE 1905.1/1a stack, including functions to build, process, and identify M1 and M2 messages used in device configuration protocols.

methods.name: wscBuildM1
methods.description: Builds an M1 message for device configuration, taking the interface name and returning a data buffer and key.

methods.name: wscProcessM2
methods.description: Processes a received M2 message to configure the device, using the key and associated M1 data.

methods.name: wscBuildM2
methods.description: Builds an M2 message based on the received M1 message, with platform-specific variation when MULTIAP is defined.

methods.name: wscFreeM2
methods.description: Frees the M2 message buffer once it is no longer needed.

methods.name: wscGetType
methods.description: Determines the type of WSC message (M1, M2, or unknown).
